results.text: Three lid hacks that keep my bottle from leaking in a packed backpack #waterbottle #packhacks
Is a 32 oz bottle too much for a desk job? A week of testing sizes #hydration #desksetup

task.goal: Understand early engagement patterns for water-bottle content and propose next topics.
task.comparison_limits: Posts were published on different days by different authors; view counts are not age-normalized.
task.content_goal: Identify themes from post text that the account could test next.
task.metric_definition: Engagement rate = (likes + comments + shares) / views, for each post and pooled over eligible posts.

sample_and_window.sampling_method: TikTok search results supplied by the user; selection and ranking method unknown; not a random sample.

rates.name: engagement_rate_SYNTH-POST-03
rates.reason: view_count is 0 (zero denominator) and comment_count was not returned.

rates.name: pooled_engagement_rate
rates.formula: sum(like_count + comment_count + share_count) / sum(view_count) over the same eligible posts = (40+5+5+40+4+6)/(1000+2000) = 100/3000
rates.exclusion_reason: zero denominator (view_count 0) and comment_count not returned
rates.note: Not the unweighted mean of the post rates (3.75%).

SYNTH-POST-03.comment_count: not returned (field absent); not treated as 0

missing_data.returned_zeros: SYNTH-POST-03 view_count, like_count, and share_count are returned zeros.
not_returned_for_any_record: per-record capture time (only the task capture time)
separate caption and tag fields (hashtags appear inside text)
missing_data.times: posted_at was returned for all three posts.

comparability.shared: All three are TikTok posts from the same search action with the same metric set, except that SYNTH-POST-03 lacks comment_count.
comparability.valid_with_caveats: SYNTH-POST-01 vs SYNTH-POST-02 engagement rates (5.0% vs 2.5%), keeping the age and author differences in view.
invalid_comparisons: Raw view counts across posts: ages differ and views are not age-normalized.
Any rate comparison involving SYNTH-POST-03: its rate is unavailable.
Author-level conclusions: each author has a single post.

content_patterns.theme: practical fix for a leak problem
content_patterns.evidence: "Three lid hacks that keep my bottle from leaking in a packed backpack"
content_patterns.observed_performance: 5.0% engagement rate on 1000 views; the higher rate of the two computable posts.
content_patterns.caveat: One post; the oldest in the sample.

content_patterns.theme: bottle-size question for a daily setting
content_patterns.evidence: "Is a 32 oz bottle too much for a desk job? A week of testing sizes"
content_patterns.observed_performance: 2.5% engagement rate; 2000 views, the most in the sample although about a day younger than SYNTH-POST-01.
content_patterns.caveat: One post; question format and a different author.

content_patterns.observed_performance: 0 views, 0 likes, and 0 shares returned; comment_count not returned; rate unavailable.
content_patterns.caveat: The text is too short to tell what the video shows; youngest post (30 h at capture).

next_topics.hypothesis: Problem-solution clips with a concrete fix may earn more engagement per view than open sizing questions.
next_topics.test_idea: Publish one fix-style clip and one sizing-question clip from the same account in the same week; compare engagement rates at the same post age.
next_topics.uncertainty: Two posts with different authors and ages; not causal.

next_topics.hypothesis: Bottle-size questions tied to a daily setting may reach more viewers, even at a lower engagement rate.
next_topics.test_idea: Post two setting-based sizing clips (for example desk and gym) and compare views at equal age.
next_topics.uncertainty: One post; reach also depends on distribution that the caption does not explain.

next_topics.hypothesis: A descriptive caption may help early distribution compared with a two-word caption.
next_topics.test_idea: Re-check SYNTH-POST-03 at a later capture, then post comparable footage with a descriptive caption and compare at equal age.
next_topics.uncertainty: The zero views may reflect timing or distribution rather than the caption; the video content is unknown.
